name: Dumbbell Box Squat
steps: Stand a few inches in front of a bench with feet shoulder-width apart and dumbbells at your sides.
Brace your core, push your hips back, and bend your knees to lower smoothly onto the bench.
Touch the bench lightly under control without relaxing your posture or rocking backward.
Drive through both feet to stand tall, squeezing your glutes at the top.
tips: Keep tension through your core and thighs as you contact the bench instead of plopping down.
Keep your heels flat and knees tracking in line with your toes.
